s: Which one of the following statements correctly distinguishes Articles 29 and 30?
o: Article 29 protects any section of citizens, whereas Article 30 applies to religious or linguistic minorities.
Article 29 applies only to minorities, whereas Article 30 applies to every citizen.
Article 30 deals only with admission, whereas Article 29 deals only with aided institutions.
Both Articles apply exclusively to religious minorities.
x: Article 29(1) protects any section of citizens with a distinct language, script or culture, while Article 30 protects the rights of religious and linguistic minorities to establish and administer educational institutions.
tq: Compare the scope of the two Articles rather than treating both as identical minority provisions.

Consider the following statements regarding minority educational institutions:
1. Religious and linguistic minorities may establish and administer educational institutions of their choice.
2. The State may regulate educational standards.
3. The State may completely take away the management of such institutions as a matter of regulation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: Article 30 protects the right to establish and administer institutions, although the State may regulate standards. Regulation cannot ordinarily destroy the management right.
tq: Distinguish permissible regulation from an impermissible takeover of management.
